'''Kamitra Cigars''' are a '''Legal Drugs''' rare commodity produced exclusively by '''Hammel Terminal''' in the Kamitra system (not to be confused with Hera Tani's own system, [[Kuwemaki]]).<ref name="inara-cigars">[https://inara.cz/elite/commodity/10030/ Kamitra Cigars — Commodity], Inara.</ref> They are legal to carry almost everywhere; Inara's data lists a small number of government types (Prison Colony, Theocracy, Corporate, and Federal Democracy systems) where they are not.<ref name="inara-cigars" />

== Why it matters for Engineering ==

[[Hera Tani]] requires '''50 units of Kamitra Cigars''' to unlock her Engineering workshop at [[The Jet's Hole]] in [[Kuwemaki]]. As a commodity, each unit occupies one tonne of cargo space.

== Acquisition ==

Like all rare commodities, Kamitra Cigars have a single fixed production source — Hammel Terminal in Kamitra — and follow rare-goods stocking rules rather than an ordinary market's supply:<ref name="inara-cigars" />

* Only a small batch is available at any one time (allocation is typically a handful of units per visit, not the full 50).
* Stock replenishes gradually while docked, roughly every several minutes, up to a per-visit cap.
* Rares stop restocking once your hold already contains your maximum allocation, so buying, then waiting, then buying again is normally required to reach 50 units in one visit; splitting the purchase across repeat visits to Hammel Terminal also works.

{{Tip|Because Kamitra Cigars only originate from Hammel Terminal, plan the trip around that one station rather than searching general commodity markets — ordinary market searches will not turn up rare goods the way they do standard commodities.}}

Player-owned [[Fleet Carrier|Fleet Carriers]] may also carry Kamitra Cigars if another Commander has stocked them for resale; carrier inventory and prices are player-controlled and can change.
